# Lifecoaching
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Aarthi | Life &amp; Career Transition Coaching | Book a free session</title>
<meta name="description" content="Coaching for burnout and life or career transitions. Book a free 30-minute conversation and see if we click.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Figtree:wght@400;500;600&family=Young+Serif&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
  :root{
    --paper:#F2EBDD;
    --sand:#E6D8BD;
    --sand-deep:#D8C6A3;
    --moss:#6F7F5B;
    --moss-light:#A9B591;
    --forest:#2F3B2D;
    --forest-deep:#232C21;
    --ink:#3E3226;
    --ink-soft:#6A5B4A;
    --sun:#DDA24B;
    --sun-deep:#C98C33;
    --serif:"Young Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;
    --sans:"Figtree", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
  }

  *,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:1.0625rem;
    line-height:1.65;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  /* soft paper grain */
  body::before{
    content:"";
    position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; opacity:.35;
    background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='160' height='160'><filter id='n'><feTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='.8' numOctaves='2' stitchTiles='stitch'/><feColorMatrix values='0 0 0 0 .35  0 0 0 0 .28  0 0 0 0 .2  0 0 0 .12 0'/></filter><rect width='100%' height='100%' filter='url(%23n)'/></svg>");
  }
  main,header,footer,section{position:relative; z-index:1}

  h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif); font-weight:400; line-height:1.15; margin:0; letter-spacing:-.01em}
  h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem, 5.2vw, 3.9rem)}
  h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem, 3.6vw, 2.7rem)}
  h3{font-size:1.3rem}
  p{margin:0 0 1.1em}
  a{color:inherit}
  :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--sun); outline-offset:3px; border-radius:6px}

  .wrap{width:min(1120px, 100% - 2.5rem); margin-inline:auto}
  .narrow{width:min(700px, 100% - 2.5rem); margin-inline:auto}
  .section{padding:clamp(4rem, 9vw, 7rem) 0}
  .lede{font-size:1.2rem; color:var(--ink-soft)}

  /* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
  .btn{
    display:inline-block; text-align:center;
    background:var(--sun); color:var(--forest-deep);
    font-family:var(--sans); font-weight:600; font-size:1.05rem;
    padding:1rem 1.9rem; border-radius:999px;
    text-decoration:none; border:0; cursor:pointer;
    box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--sun-deep), 0 10px 24px -12px rgba(90,60,10,.55);
    transition:transform .18s ease, background .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }
  .btn:hover{background:#E4AC58; transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 4px 0 var(--sun-deep), 0 14px 26px -12px rgba(90,60,10,.55)}
  .btn:active{transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--sun-deep)}
  .btn-small{padding:.55rem 1.15rem; font-size:.95rem; box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--sun-deep)}
  .text-link{font-weight:600; text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:5px; text-decoration-thickness:2px; text-decoration-color:var(--moss)}
  .text-link:hover{text-decoration-color:var(--sun-deep)}

  /* ---------- Sketch styling ---------- */
  .sketch{filter:url(#rough)}
  .sketch *{vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
  .line{fill:none; stroke:var(--ink); stroke-width:2.2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round}

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  .nav{padding:1.2rem 0}
  .nav .wrap{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem}
  .brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.7rem; text-decoration:none}
  .mark{
    width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--forest); color:var(--paper);
    display:grid; place-items:center;
    font-family:var(--serif); font-size:1.05rem; letter-spacing:.02em;
  }
  .brand-text{display:flex; flex-direction:column; line-height:1.2}
  .brand-name{font-family:var(--serif); font-size:1.15rem}
  .brand-sub{font-size:.82rem; color:var(--ink-soft)}
  @media (max-width:560px){ .brand-sub{display:none} }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{padding:clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem) 0 clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5.5rem)}
  .hero .wrap{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr; gap:clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 4rem); align-items:center}
  .hero h1{margin-bottom:1.4rem; max-width:14ch}
  .hero .lede{max-width:34rem; margin-bottom:2rem}
  .hero-actions{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:1.4rem 1.8rem}
  .hero-note{margin:1.4rem 0 0; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.98rem}
  .hero-art-wrap{border-radius:170px 170px 32px 32px; overflow:hidden; background:linear-gradient(180deg,#EFE0BF 0%,#F2EBDD 75%); border:2px solid var(--sand-deep)}
  .hero-art{width:100%; height:auto; display:block}
  @media (max-width:860px){
    .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
    .hero-art-wrap{max-width:460px; margin-inline:auto; width:100%}
    .hero h1{max-width:none}
  }

  /* One orchestrated moment: the sun rises, then the words settle in */
  @keyframes rise{from{transform:translateY(95px); opacity:0} 40%{opacity:1} to{transform:translateY(0); opacity:1}}
  @keyframes settle{from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px)} to{opacity:1; transform:none}}
  .sun-group{animation:rise 2.6s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
  .hero-in{animation:settle .9s ease-out both}
  .hero-in.d1{animation-delay:.25s}
  .hero-in.d2{animation-delay:.55s}
  .hero-in.d3{animation-delay:.85s}
  .hero-in.d4{animation-delay:1.1s}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    .sun-group,.hero-in{animation:none}
    html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  }

  /* ---------- I see you ---------- */
  .seeyou h2{max-width:20ch; margin-bottom:3rem}
  .feelings{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:0 4rem; list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0}
  .feelings li{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:56px 1fr; gap:1.2rem; align-items:center;
    padding:1.6rem 0; border-top:2px dashed var(--sand-deep);
    font-size:1.15rem;
  }
  .feelings svg{width:56px; height:56px; color:var(--moss)}
  .feelings .line{stroke:currentColor}
  .seeyou-close{margin-top:2.5rem; padding-top:2rem; border-top:2px dashed var(--sand-deep); max-width:44rem; font-size:1.2rem}
  @media (max-width:760px){ .feelings{grid-template-columns:1fr} }

  /* ---------- Why ---------- */
  .why .wrap{display:grid; grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr; gap:clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem); align-items:center}
  .why h2{margin-bottom:1.6rem}
  .why-art{width:100%; max-width:380px; height:auto; margin-inline:auto; display:block}
  .belief{
    font-family:var(--serif); font-size:1.4rem; line-height:1.35;
    border-left:4px solid var(--sun); padding:.2rem 0 .2rem 1.4rem; margin:2rem 0 0;
  }
  @media (min-width:861px){ .why .wrap{grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr} .why-art{order:2} }
  @media (max-width:860px){ .why .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr} .why-art{max-width:300px} }

  /* ---------- Reframe ---------- */
  .reframe{background:var(--forest); color:var(--paper); overflow:hidden}
  .reframe .wrap{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr .7fr; gap:3rem; align-items:center}
  .reframe h2{font-size:clamp(2rem, 4.6vw, 3.4rem); margin-bottom:1.6rem}
  .reframe p{color:#DDD6C4; max-width:36rem; font-size:1.15rem}
  .reframe .line{stroke:#E9E0C9}
  .reframe-art{width:100%; max-width:340px; height:auto; margin-inline:auto; display:block}
  @media (max-width:860px){ .reframe .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr} .reframe-art{max-width:260px} }

  /* ---------- How ---------- */
  .how h2{margin-bottom:.8rem}
  .how .lede{margin-bottom:3.2rem; max-width:34rem}
  .steps{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:2.5rem; list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0; counter-reset:step}
  .step{position:relative}
  .step svg{width:120px; height:120px; display:block; margin-bottom:1rem}
  .step .line{stroke:var(--forest)}
  .step-num{
    font-family:var(--serif); font-size:1rem; color:var(--paper); background:var(--moss);
    width:32px; height:32px; border-radius:50%; display:inline-grid; place-items:center; margin-bottom:.9rem;
  }
  .step h3{margin-bottom:.5rem}
  .step p{color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0}
  /* stepping stones rise from left to right, like the path itself */
  .step:nth-child(2){margin-top:1.5rem}
  .step:nth-child(3){margin-top:3rem}
  @media (max-width:820px){
    .steps{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:2.2rem}
    .step:nth-child(n){margin-top:0}
    .step{display:grid; grid-template-columns:96px 1fr; gap:0 1.3rem; align-items:start}
    .step svg{width:96px; height:96px; grid-row:1 / span 3}
  }

  /* ---------- Free session ---------- */
  .session{background:var(--sand)}
  .session-card{
    background:var(--paper); border-radius:28px; padding:clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
    border:2px solid var(--sand-deep);
    box-shadow:8px 8px 0 var(--sand-deep);
  }
  .session-head{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:1rem 2rem; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:1.6rem}
  .session h2{max-width:18ch}
  .duration{
    font-family:var(--serif); text-align:center; line-height:1;
    background:var(--forest); color:var(--paper); border-radius:50%;
    width:104px; height:104px; display:grid; place-content:center; flex:none;
  }
  .duration b{font-weight:400; font-size:2.3rem}
  .duration span{font-family:var(--sans); font-size:.85rem; opacity:.85}
  .session-intro{max-width:44rem; font-size:1.15rem; margin-bottom:2.2rem}
  .compare{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr; gap:2rem 3rem; margin-bottom:2.4rem}
  .compare h3{margin-bottom:1rem}
  .compare ul{list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0}
  .compare li{position:relative; padding-left:2rem; margin-bottom:.8rem}
  .compare .is li::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; left:0; top:.45em; width:.9rem; height:.5rem;
    border-left:3px solid var(--moss); border-bottom:3px solid var(--moss); transform:rotate(-45deg);
  }
  .compare .isnt li{color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .compare .isnt li::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; left:.05rem; top:.85em; width:.9rem; border-top:3px solid var(--sand-deep);
  }
  .session-foot{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:1rem 1.6rem}
  .session-foot span{color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:.98rem}
  @media (max-width:760px){ .compare{grid-template-columns:1fr} }

  /* ---------- Promise ---------- */
  .promise h2{margin-bottom:1rem; max-width:18ch}
  .promise .lede{max-width:40rem; margin-bottom:3rem}
  .promises{list-style:none; padding:0; margin:0; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:2.4rem 4rem}
  .promises li{display:grid; grid-template-columns:44px 1fr; gap:1rem}
  .promises svg{width:44px; height:44px; color:var(--moss)}
  .promises .line{stroke:currentColor}
  .promises h3{margin-bottom:.3rem; font-size:1.25rem}
  .promises p{margin:0; color:var(--ink-soft)}
  .testimonial-slot:empty{display:none}
  @media (max-width:760px){ .promises{grid-template-columns:1fr} }

  /* ---------- About ---------- */
  .about{background:var(--sand)}
  .about .wrap{display:grid; grid-template-columns:.75fr 1.25fr; gap:clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem); align-items:center}
  .photo{
    aspect-ratio:4/5; width:100%; max-width:380px; margin-inline:auto;
    border-radius:999px 999px 28px 28px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, var(--moss-light), var(--moss));
    display:grid; place-items:center; text-align:center; color:var(--forest-deep);
    border:3px solid var(--forest); position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    display:block; object-fit:cover; height:auto;
  }
  .about h2{margin-bottom:1.4rem}
  .credential{
    margin-top:1.8rem; padding:1.1rem 1.3rem; background:var(--paper); border-radius:16px;
    border-left:4px solid var(--moss); color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:1rem;
  }
  @media (max-width:860px){ .about .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr} .photo{max-width:300px} }

  /* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
  .faq{background:var(--sand)}
  .faq details{border-color:#C7B18A}
  .faq h2{margin-bottom:2.2rem}
  details{border-top:2px dashed var(--sand-deep)}
  details:last-of-type{border-bottom:2px dashed var(--sand-deep)}
  summary{
    list-style:none; cursor:pointer; padding:1.35rem 3rem 1.35rem 0; position:relative;
    font-family:var(--serif); font-size:1.2rem; line-height:1.35;
  }
  summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
  summary::before,summary::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; right:.3rem; top:50%; width:18px; height:2.5px; background:var(--moss);
    transition:transform .25s ease;
  }
  summary::after{transform:rotate(90deg)}
  details[open] summary::after{transform:rotate(0deg)}
  details p{padding:0 3rem 1.5rem 0; color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0}

  /* ---------- Final CTA ---------- */
  .final{background:var(--forest); color:var(--paper); text-align:center; overflow:hidden}
  .final .narrow{position:relative; z-index:2}
  .final h2{margin-bottom:1.1rem}
  .final p{color:#DDD6C4; font-size:1.2rem; margin-bottom:2rem}
  .final-art{position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; width:100%; height:auto; z-index:1; opacity:.9}
  .final .section-inner{padding-bottom:clamp(5rem, 14vw, 10rem)}

  /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
  footer{background:var(--forest-deep); color:#CFC8B4; padding:2.6rem 0 6rem; font-size:.95rem}
  footer .wrap{display:grid; gap:1.1rem}
  footer p{margin:0; max-width:52rem}
  footer strong{color:var(--paper); font-weight:600}
  .crisis{border-left:4px solid var(--sun); padding-left:1rem}


  /* ---------- Booking pop-up ---------- */
  dialog.booking{
    width:min(980px, 96vw); height:min(780px, 92vh); max-width:none; max-height:none;
    padding:0; border:0; border-radius:24px; overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink);
    box-shadow:0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  }
  dialog.booking[open]{display:grid; grid-template-rows:auto 1fr auto}
  dialog.booking::backdrop{background:rgba(20,28,30,.6); backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
  .booking-bar{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1rem;
    padding:.9rem 1.2rem .9rem 1.6rem; background:var(--sand); border-bottom:2px solid var(--sand-deep);
  }
  .booking-title{margin:0; font-family:var(--serif); font-size:1.15rem; line-height:1.3}
  .booking-close{
    flex:none; width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%; border:0; cursor:pointer;
    background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink); display:grid; place-items:center;
    transition:background .18s ease;
  }
  .booking-close:hover{background:#fff}
  .booking-body{position:relative; min-height:0; background:var(--paper)}
  .booking-body iframe{position:relative; z-index:1; width:100%; height:100%; border:0; background:transparent}
  .booking-loading,.booking-setup{
    position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; display:grid; place-content:center; text-align:center;
    padding:2rem; margin:0; color:var(--ink-soft);
  }
  .booking-setup{z-index:2; background:var(--paper)}
  .booking-setup[hidden]{display:none}
  .booking-setup code{background:var(--sand); padding:.1rem .4rem; border-radius:6px}
  .booking-foot{margin:0; padding:.7rem 1.2rem; font-size:.92rem; text-align:center; color:var(--ink-soft); border-top:2px solid var(--sand-deep); background:var(--paper)}
  @media (max-width:640px){
    dialog.booking{width:100vw; height:100dvh; border-radius:0}
    .booking-title{font-size:1rem}
  }

  /* ---------- Mobile sticky CTA ---------- */
  .sticky-cta{
    position:fixed; left:0; right:0; bottom:0; z-index:20;
    padding:.8rem 1rem calc(.8rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
    background:rgba(47,59,45,.96); display:none; justify-content:center;
    transform:translateY(110%); transition:transform .3s ease;
  }
  .sticky-cta.show{transform:none}
  .sticky-cta .btn{width:100%; max-width:420px; text-align:center}
  @media (max-width:760px){ .sticky-cta{display:flex} }
</style>
</head>

<body>

<!-- Shared filter that gives every sketch a hand-drawn wobble -->
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
  <filter id="rough" x="-5%" y="-5%" width="110%" height="110%">
    <feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency="0.035" numOctaves="2" seed="4" result="n"/>
    <feDisplacementMap in="SourceGraphic" in2="n" scale="2.4"/>
  </filter>
</svg>

<!-- ============ NAV ============ -->
<header class="nav">
  <div class="wrap">
    <a class="brand" href="#top" aria-label="Aarthi, home">
      <span class="mark">A</span>
      <span class="brand-text">
        <span class="brand-name">Aarthi</span>
        <span class="brand-sub">Life &amp; career transition coaching</span>
      </span>
    </a>
    <a class="btn btn-small" data-cta href="#">Book free session</a>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">

  <!-- ============ HERO ============ -->
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div>
        <h1 class="hero-in d1">Feeling stuck in a chapter you didn't choose?</h1>
        <p class="lede hero-in d2">Maybe it's burnout. Maybe it's a career crossroads, or a change in life that shook everything loose. You don't have to figure out the next step by yourself. Let's talk.</p>
        <div class="hero-actions hero-in d3">
          <a class="btn" data-cta href="#">Book your free 30-minute session</a>
          <a class="text-link" href="#why">Why I do this</a>
        </div>
        <p class="hero-note hero-in d4">Come as you are. There's nothing to prepare, and no pressure.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="hero-art-wrap">
        <!-- Sketch: sunrise over hills with a winding path and a lone walker -->
        <svg class="hero-art sketch" viewBox="0 0 600 540" role="img" aria-label="Hand-drawn sketch of a sun rising over soft hills, with a winding path and a small figure walking toward the light">
          <!-- soft sky wash -->
          <circle cx="330" cy="300" r="250" fill="#EBD9B4" opacity=".55" stroke="none"/>
          <circle cx="330" cy="300" r="170" fill="#F0CE8E" opacity=".45"/>

          <!-- the rising sun -->
          <g class="sun-group">
            <circle cx="330" cy="285" r="78" fill="#DDA24B"/>
            <circle cx="330" cy="285" r="78" class="line" style="stroke-width:2.4"/>
            <g class="line" style="stroke:#C98C33">
              <path d="M330 175 V152"/><path d="M262 198 L246 180"/><path d="M398 198 L414 180"/>
              <path d="M225 262 L200 254"/><path d="M435 262 L460 254"/>
            </g>
          </g>

          <!-- clouds -->
          <path class="line" d="M120 140 c10 -22 42 -22 52 -4 c18 -8 36 4 30 18 h-88 c-8 -2 -8 -10 6 -14z" style="stroke:#8B7A63"/>
          <path class="line" d="M410 110 c8 -16 32 -16 40 -3 c14 -6 28 3 23 14 h-68 c-6 -2 -6 -8 5 -11z" style="stroke:#8B7A63"/>

          <!-- birds -->
          <path class="line" d="M150 210 q8 -10 16 0 q8 -10 16 0"/>
          <path class="line" d="M190 175 q6 -8 12 0 q6 -8 12 0"/>

          <!-- hills -->
          <path d="M0 345 C 80 300, 170 292, 255 328 S 430 322, 510 292 S 585 300, 600 306 V540 H0Z" fill="#CBD2B8" stroke="#3E3226" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <path d="M0 395 C 90 355, 190 362, 285 392 S 455 384, 600 352 V540 H0Z" fill="#A9B591" stroke="#3E3226" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
          <path d="M0 455 C 120 425, 240 445, 345 465 S 525 447, 600 436 V540 H0Z" fill="#6F7F5B" stroke="#3E3226" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

          <!-- winding path -->
          <path d="M235 540 C 300 505, 190 470, 275 440 S 340 395, 336 352" fill="none" stroke="#F2EBDD" stroke-width="16" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".95"/>
          <path d="M235 540 C 300 505, 190 470, 275 440 S 340 395, 336 352" class="line" stroke-dasharray="2 9" style="stroke-width:1.6"/>

          <!-- lone walker -->
          <g class="line" style="stroke-width:2.6">
            <circle cx="289" cy="418" r="5.5" fill="#3E3226"/>
            <path d="M289 424 V443"/>
            <path d="M289 443 L283 458"/><path d="M289 443 L296 457"/>
            <path d="M289 429 L281 438"/><path d="M289 429 L298 435"/>
          </g>

          <!-- little sapling on the left -->
          <g class="line" style="stroke:#2F3B2D">
            <path d="M92 470 C 92 450, 94 438, 92 424"/>
            <path d="M92 442 C 76 440, 70 428, 76 420 C 90 420, 95 432, 92 442" fill="#A9B591"/>
            <path d="M92 432 C 106 430, 112 418, 106 410 C 94 410, 90 422, 92 432" fill="#A9B591"/>
          </g>
          <!-- grass tufts -->
          <g class="line" style="stroke:#2F3B2D">
            <path d="M470 480 l-4 -14 M476 480 l0 -16 M482 480 l5 -13"/>
            <path d="M150 505 l-4 -12 M156 505 l0 -14 M162 505 l4 -11"/>
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ I SEE YOU ============ -->
  <section class="section seeyou">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h2>If any of this sounds familiar</h2>
      <ul class="feelings">
        <li>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 56 56" aria-hidden="true"><g class="line"><rect x="6" y="18" width="38" height="20" rx="4"/><path d="M44 24 h5 v8 h-5"/><path d="M11 24 v8" stroke-width="4"/></g></svg>
          <span>You're tired in a way that sleep doesn't fix.</span>
        </li>
        <li>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 56 56" aria-hidden="true"><g class="line"><path d="M46 28 a18 18 0 1 1 -6 -13.5"/><path d="M42 6 v10 h-10"/></g></svg>
          <span>The days run on repeat, and you're going through the motions.</span>
        </li>
        <li>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 56 56" aria-hidden="true"><g class="line"><path d="M16 40 h24 a9 9 0 0 0 0 -18 a13 13 0 0 0 -25 -3 a10.5 10.5 0 0 0 1 21z"/><path d="M18 47 h20" stroke-dasharray="1 7"/></g></svg>
          <span>You're foggy about what you even want anymore.</span>
        </li>
        <li>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 56 56" aria-hidden="true"><g class="line"><circle cx="28" cy="28" r="19"/><path d="M36 20 L31 31 L20 36 L25 25z"/></g></svg>
          <span>You keep wondering what's next, and you're afraid to say it out loud.</span>
        </li>
      </ul>
      <p class="seeyou-close">If you nodded at even one of those, you're in the right place. It's far more common than people admit, and it's a very human place to be.</p>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ ABOUT ============ -->
  <section class="section about">
    <div class="wrap">
      <!-- Portrait is embedded in this file. To swap it, replace the src value with your own image path or data. -->
      <img class="photo" alt="Watercolour portrait of Aarthi smiling by the sea, with a pink flower beside her" width="720" height="900" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">

      <div>
        <h2>Hi, I'm Aarthi. Glad you're here.</h2>
        <p>Think of this as a conversation with someone who's been there. I've faced my own challenges in every phase of life, and I've learned that getting through them rarely depends on having the perfect answer. More often, it begins with someone who simply gets it.</p>
        <p>You won't be judged here. Bring the messy, half-formed thoughts, the ones that start with "this might sound silly." We'll talk it through like two people figuring things out together, sharing what we've learned and finding a way forward side by side.</p>
        <p>These days, answers are only a tap away. What's harder to find is a real person who listens, notices how you're feeling, and doesn't rush to fix it. Being heard by another human can mean more than you'd expect. That's what I'm here for.</p>
        <p class="credential">I've spent over a decade as a product and people leader in large organisations, helping teams and individuals through change, pressure and growth. I bring that experience to every conversation, along with a lot of heart.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ WHY ============ -->
  <section class="section why" id="why">
    <div class="wrap">
      <!-- Sketch: two mugs, a conversation -->
      <svg class="why-art sketch" viewBox="0 0 320 300" role="img" aria-label="Hand-drawn sketch of two steaming mugs side by side on a table, with a small plant">
        <ellipse cx="160" cy="262" rx="140" ry="10" fill="#D8C6A3"/>
        <path class="line" d="M20 258 H300"/>
        <!-- mug left -->
        <path d="M52 150 h86 v58 a34 34 0 0 1 -34 34 h-18 a34 34 0 0 1 -34 -34z" class="line" style="fill:#F2EBDD"/>
        <path class="line" d="M138 164 c26 0 26 44 0 44"/>
        <path class="line" d="M80 132 c-10 -14 10 -18 0 -34 M104 128 c-8 -12 8 -16 0 -30" style="stroke:#6F7F5B"/>
        <!-- mug right -->
        <g transform="translate(26 0)">
        <path d="M172 168 h78 v50 a30 30 0 0 1 -30 30 h-18 a30 30 0 0 1 -30 -30z" class="line" style="fill:#DDA24B"/>
        <path class="line" d="M172 180 c-24 0 -24 40 0 40"/>
        <path class="line" d="M200 150 c-9 -12 9 -16 0 -30 M224 146 c-8 -11 8 -15 0 -27" style="stroke:#6F7F5B"/>
        </g>
        <!-- little plant -->
        <g class="line" style="stroke:#2F3B2D">
          <path d="M280 258 c0 -24 2 -36 0 -52"/>
          <path d="M280 228 c-16 0 -22 -12 -16 -20 c14 0 20 10 16 20" fill="#A9B591"/>
          <path d="M280 214 c14 0 20 -12 14 -20 c-12 0 -18 10 -14 20" fill="#A9B591"/>
        </g>
      </svg>

      <div>
        <h2>Why I do this</h2>
        <p>I spent years leading teams. Somewhere along the way I noticed that the moments I remember have nothing to do with targets or milestones. They're the quiet conversations, when someone finally said out loud what they'd been carrying, and walked away a little lighter.</p>
        <p>People have always found it easy to open up to me. I've never taken that lightly. It's a kind of trust, and it matters more to me than any title I've held.</p>
        <p>So I'm doing more of it, on purpose. I coach people through burnout and life or career transitions because I believe no one should have to work through a hard chapter alone.</p>
        <p class="belief">I believe one honest conversation can change someone's week, and sometimes their whole direction.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ REFRAME ============ -->
  <section class="section reframe">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div>
        <h2>You're not broken. You're between chapters.</h2>
        <p>The exhaustion, the doubt, the restlessness: they aren't proof that something is wrong with you. Often they're a sign that the old chapter has ended and the next one hasn't started yet.</p>
        <p>That in-between is uncomfortable. It's also where the most honest work happens, and where a lot of people finally find their footing.</p>
      </div>
      <!-- Sketch: open book with a seedling -->
      <svg class="reframe-art sketch" viewBox="0 0 300 260" role="img" aria-label="Hand-drawn sketch of an open book with a small seedling growing from its centre">

  <!-- ============ HOW ============ -->
  <section class="section how">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h2>How we'll work together</h2>
      <p class="lede">Simple, because when things feel heavy, complicated is the last thing you need.</p>

      <ol class="steps">
        <li class="step">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" class="sketch" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M22 28 H98 A10 10 0 0 1 108 38 V76 A10 10 0 0 1 98 86 H62 L44 104 V86 H22 A10 10 0 0 1 12 76 V38 A10 10 0 0 1 22 28Z" class="line" style="fill:#E6D8BD"/>

          <h3>Be heard</h3>
          <p>You talk, I listen. No fixing, no rushing. Just room to say what's really going on.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="step">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" class="sketch" aria-hidden="true">
            <path class="line" d="M48 26 a12 12 0 0 1 24 0"/>
            <path d="M42 36 H78 L84 56 V86 L78 102 H42 L36 86 V56Z" class="line" style="fill:#E6D8BD"/>

          <p>Together we sort the noise from what's true, and what you actually want from here.</p>
        </li>
        <li class="step">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 120 120" class="sketch" aria-hidden="true">
            <ellipse cx="30" cy="96" rx="20" ry="8" class="line" style="fill:#D8C6A3"/>
            <ellipse cx="60" cy="74" rx="18" ry="7.5" class="line" style="fill:#D8C6A3"/>
            <ellipse cx="90" cy="52" rx="16" ry="7" class="line" style="fill:#D8C6A3"/>
            <g class="line" style="stroke:#2F3B2D">

              <path d="M90 32 C80 32 77 23 80 18 C89 18 92 25 90 32" fill="#A9B591"/>
              <path d="M90 36 C100 36 103 27 100 22 C91 22 88 29 90 36" fill="#A9B591"/>

          </svg>
          <span class="step-num">3</span>
          <h3>Take one small step</h3>
          <p>Not a life overhaul. One doable next step, then another, at a pace that feels right to you.</p>

  <!-- ============ FREE SESSION ============ -->
  <section class="section session" id="session">
    <div class="wrap">
      <div class="session-card">
        <div class="session-head">
          <h2>Your free session: let's see if we click</h2>
          <div class="duration" aria-label="30 minutes"><b>30</b><span>minutes</span></div>

        <p class="session-intro">It works both ways. You get a feel for whether I make sense to you and whether talking with me helps. I get a feel for whether I can genuinely help you. If it's not a fit, that's a perfectly good outcome, and I'll tell you honestly.</p>

        <div class="compare">
          <div class="is">
            <h3>What it is</h3>
            <ul>
              <li>A real conversation, not a sales call</li>
              <li>Your pace: share as much or as little as you like</li>
              <li>A chance to ask me anything</li>
              <li>An honest read from both of us at the end</li>
            </ul>
          </div>
          <div class="isnt">
            <h3>What it isn't</h3>
            <ul>
              <li>A pitch</li>
              <li>A commitment</li>
              <li>Therapy</li>
              <li>Homework</li>
            </ul>

        </div>

        <div class="session-foot">
          <a class="btn" data-cta href="#">Pick a time that suits you</a>
          <span>Free. No card needed, no obligation.</span>
        </div>

  </section>

  <!-- ============ PROMISE (in place of testimonials for now) ============ -->
  <section class="section promise">
    <div class="wrap">
      <h2>My promise to you</h2>
      <p class="lede">I'm just beginning this chapter myself, and I'd be honoured to walk alongside my first few clients. Here's what you can count on from the very first conversation.</p>

      <ul class="promises">
        <li>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" aria-hidden="true" class="sketch"><g class="line"><path d="M8 18 c0 -8 6 -12 12 -12 s14 4 14 12 c0 8 -6 8 -6 14 c0 4 -4 6 -8 6"/><path d="M22 14 c-4 0 -6 3 -5 6"/><circle cx="21" cy="40" r="1" fill="currentColor"/></g></svg>

        <li>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" aria-hidden="true" class="sketch"><g class="line"><path d="M6 24 c6 -8 12 -8 16 0 s10 8 16 0"/><path d="M6 32 c6 -8 12 -8 16 0 s10 8 16 0" opacity=".5"/></g></svg>

          <div>

          </div>

          <svg viewBox="0 0 44 44" aria-hidden="true" class="sketch"><g class="line"><path d="M8 34 C8 20 18 10 36 8 C36 26 28 34 8 34z"/><path d="M8 34 C16 26 22 20 30 14"/></g></svg>
          <div>
            <h3>If I'm not the right person, I'll say so</h3>

      <!-- TESTIMONIAL SLOT: once you have permission from a client, add their words here, e.g.
      <blockquote class="belief">"..." <br>Name, role</blockquote>
      -->
      <div class="testimonial-slot"></div>

  <!-- ============ FAQ ============ -->
  <section class="section faq">
    <div class="narrow">
      <h2>Questions you might have</h2>

      <details>
        <summary>Is this therapy?</summary>
        <p>No. Coaching looks forward: getting clear on where you are, where you want to go, and what to do next. It isn't treatment for mental health conditions. If you're dealing with depression, trauma, or anxiety that's affecting daily life, a licensed professional is the right support, and I'm happy to help you work out what fits.</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>What if I don't know what I want?</summary>
        <p>That's exactly where most people begin. You don't need a goal to book a session. Feeling lost is a perfectly good reason to talk.</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Is the first session really free?</summary>
        <p>Yes. It's 30 minutes, with no payment details and no obligation. It's simply a chance for us both to see whether working together makes sense.</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Do I need to prepare anything?</summary>
        <p>Nothing at all. Come as you are. If it helps, you can jot down a few words about what's been on your mind, but it's completely optional.</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>What happens after the free session?</summary>
        <p>If we both feel it's a good fit, we can talk about what working together might look like. If not, there's no follow-up pressure. You're free to take your time or walk away.</p>
      </details>
      <details>
        <summary>Will what I share stay private?</summary>
        <p>Yes. What you share with me stays between us. It's a safe space to speak openly.</p>
      </details>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ============ FINAL CTA ============ -->
  <section class="section final" id="book">

    <p>Coaching is not a substitute for therapy, counselling, or medical care, and it does not diagnose or treat mental health conditions. If you're struggling with your mental health, please speak with a licensed professional.</p>

<!-- Booking pop-up: opens when any "Book" button is clicked -->
<dialog class="booking" id="bookingDialog" aria-labelledby="bookingTitle">
  <div class="booking-bar">
    <p class="booking-title" id="bookingTitle">Pick a time for your free 30-minute session</p>
    <button type="button" class="booking-close" id="bookingClose" aria-label="Close booking window">
      <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 3 L15 15 M15 3 L3 15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg>
    </button>
  </div>
  <div class="booking-body">
    <p class="booking-loading">Loading the calendar&hellip;</p>
    <div class="booking-setup" id="bookingSetup" hidden>
      <div>
        <p><strong>Booking isn't connected yet.</strong></p>
        <p>Paste your Calendly link into the <code>CALENDLY_URL</code> line at the bottom of this file.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <iframe id="bookingFrame" title="Schedule a free session with Aarthi"></iframe>
  </div>
  <p class="booking-foot">Calendar not loading? <a id="bookingFallback" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open it in a new tab</a></p>
</dialog>

<!-- Sticky booking bar (mobile only) -->
<div class="sticky-cta" id="stickyCta">
  <a class="btn" data-cta href="#">Book your free session</a>
</div>

<script>
  /* =====================================================
     EDIT THIS ONE LINE: paste your Calendly link below.
     Every "Book" button on the page will use it.
     ===================================================== */
  var CALENDLY_URL = "https://calendly.com/YOUR-CALENDLY-LINK";

  /* Every "Book" button opens the calendar in a pop-up on this page.
     (Ctrl/Cmd-click or middle-click still opens Calendly in a new tab.) */
  var dialog   = document.getElementById("bookingDialog");
  var frame    = document.getElementById("bookingFrame");
  var setup    = document.getElementById("bookingSetup");
  var titleEl  = document.getElementById("bookingTitle");
  var loaded   = false;
  var notSetUp = /YOUR-CALENDLY-LINK/.test(CALENDLY_URL);

  function themeColor(name) {
    return getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(name).trim().replace("#", "");
  }
  function embedUrl() {
    var sep = CALENDLY_URL.indexOf("?") > -1 ? "&" : "?";
    return CALENDLY_URL + sep +
      "embed_domain=" + encodeURIComponent(location.hostname || "localhost") +
      "&embed_type=Inline&hide_gdpr_banner=1" +
      "&background_color=" + themeColor("--paper") +
      "&text_color=" + themeColor("--ink") +
      "&primary_color=" + themeColor("--forest");
  }
  function openBooking() {
    if (notSetUp) {
      setup.hidden = false;
    } else if (!loaded) {
      frame.src = embedUrl();
      loaded = true;
    }
    dialog.showModal();
    document.documentElement.style.overflow = "hidden";
  }

  document.getElementById("bookingFallback").href = CALENDLY_URL;
  document.getElementById("bookingClose").addEventListener("click", function () { dialog.close(); });
  dialog.addEventListener("click", function (e) { if (e.target === dialog) dialog.close(); });
  dialog.addEventListener("close", function () { document.documentElement.style.overflow = ""; });

  /* Friendly confirmation once someone books */
  window.addEventListener("message", function (e) {
    if (e.origin === "https://calendly.com" && e.data && e.data.event === "calendly.event_scheduled") {
      titleEl.textContent = "You're booked. Looking forward to talking with you.";
    }
  });

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-cta]").forEach(function (a) {
    a.href = CALENDLY_URL;
    a.target = "_blank";
    a.rel = "noopener";
    a.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.shiftKey || e.button !== 0) return;
      if (typeof dialog.showModal !== "function") return;  /* old browser: falls back to new tab */
      e.preventDefault();
      openBooking();
    });
  });

  /* Mobile sticky bar: appears after the hero, hides at the final CTA */
  (function () {
    var bar = document.getElementById("stickyCta");
    var final = document.getElementById("book");
    function update() {
      var y = window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset;
      var finalTop = final.getBoundingClientRect().top;
      var show = y > 600 && finalTop > window.innerHeight * 0.7;
      bar.classList.toggle("show", show);
    }
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: true });
    update();
  })();
</script>
</body>
</html>
